description: Rate limits: fixed-window counters in shared Redis. On each request: INCR key; if the result is 1, EXPIRE key windowSec. windowStartEpochSec = floor(nowEpochSec / windowSec) * windowSec. Over limit -> 429 Problem RATE_LIMITED, Retry-After = windowStartEpochSec + windowSec - nowEpochSec (>= 1), params {scope, limit, windowSec}. Subject email is lowercased before use. Scope 'user' applies to every request authenticated with a Bearer token; other scopes apply to the operations listing them in the OpenAPI extension x-rate-limit.
